_about: The planting belts round the far rails, as built by tools/blender/build_planting.py from courses/ascot.json (re-run it rather than editing). World axes as courses/ascot.json (x east, z south). boards: x, z, turn (degrees anticlockwise seen from above; 0 = the board's front faces +z, south), design (node board_<design> in the model). trees: x, z, tree (crown and trunk nodes <tree>_crown, <tree>_crown_far and <tree>_trunk in assets/models/trees/trees.glb), scale, turn. The hedge (node planting_hedge) is in world axes already.
